nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 20 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent observations: one updated at 06:08 WAT on 23 Nov and one dated 21 Nov (previous close; time not stated), rechecked at 06:15 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
